name: zil-site
description: The docs site: the mdBook reference, the sandbox, and the wasm build both run. Needs mdbook, the wasm32-unknown-unknown target and wasm-bindgen-cli at Cargo.lock's wasm-bindgen version.

scripts.build: pnpm book && pnpm wasm && mdbook build docs/book && node docs/stage.mjs site
scripts.wasm: cargo wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir docs/sandbox/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/zil.wasm && node docs/stage.mjs examples
